    Bar snacksCharred pineapple salsa with lime chipsPineapple and jalapeño salsa. Saul steals a police car for the chaseHow to make it1/2 pineapple1 red onion1 jalapeño1 bunch coriander3 limes250g corn chipsCut half a pineapple into thick slices and char on a very hot grill pan for 3 minutes a side.Cool and dice.Mix with half a finely diced red onion, the chopped jalapeño, a handful of chopped coriander, the juice of the limes and salt.Rest 10 minutes.Toss the corn chips with the zest of the lime and a little salt and serve with the salsa.Saul's cheesy garlic pull-apart breadGarlic cheese cob. Saul's in the dumpster alreadyHow to make it1 cob loaf100g butter3 garlic cloves1 bunch parsley200g mozzarella40g parmesanfoil, to tasteHeat the oven to 190°C.Cut a cob loaf in a crosshatch pattern, 2cm apart, without cutting through the base.Melt the butter with the crushed garlic cloves and the chopped parsley.Spoon into all the cuts, then stuff with the grated mozzarella and the parmesan.Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes, then unwrap and bake 10 minutes until golden and melted.PlatesRed's pineapple teriyaki chickenTeriyaki thighs, pineapple, rice. Red's boiling some eggs over hereHow to make it1kg chicken thigh fillets100ml soy sauce60ml mirin3 tbsp brown sugar1 knob ginger1 garlic clove1 pineapple1 1/2 cups jasmine ricesesame seeds, to taste2 spring onions1 red chillirice vinegar, to tasteSimmer the soy, the mirin, the brown sugar, the grated ginger and the garlic clove for 5 minutes until syrupy.Marinate the chicken thighs in half the sauce for 30 minutes.Grill on a hot barbecue for 5 to 6 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce.Grill the pineapple slices 2 minutes a side.Cook the rice.Slice the chicken and serve with pineapple, sesame, spring onion and sliced chilli in vinegar.AftersRed's cat's pineapple upside-down cakePineapple upside-down. It's Red's cat's birthday todayHow to make it185g butter100g brown sugar2 tbsp dark rum1 pineapple150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml milk200ml coconut creamHeat the oven to 180°C.Melt the butter with the brown sugar and the dark rum in a 23cm tin and lay the fresh pineapple rings on top.Beat the butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs, then the self-raising flour and the milk.Spread over the fruit and bake 45 minutes.Rest 5 minutes and turn out.Serve warm with the chilled coconut cream.Behind the barPineapple mint rum crushRum, pineapple and mint. Chill as a cucumberHow to make it1/2 pineapple1 bunch mint60ml brown sugar syrup4 limes180ml white rum250ml pineapple juicechilli powder, to taste3 cups crushed ice1 tbsp saltMix the salt with a little chilli powder and rim the glasses.For each drink, muddle the pineapple chunks, a few mint leaves, the brown sugar syrup and the lime juice in a shaker.Add the white rum and the pineapple juice, shake with ice and pour over crushed ice.For non-drinkers, skip the rum and top with soda.Iced horchata with cinnamonTalk radio killed the car battery.
